The same paper is used which takes pencils quite nicely and it also stood up quite well to my use of acrylic paint and Derwent Inktense.  There was obviously some warping of the paper with my use of activating the Inktense with water but the paper started laying flat pretty easily after the book was closed and a few other books were sat on top of it.The images in the book range from mandala style to landscapes and really has a little bit of something for all those colorists that love nature themed books. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: My fave national park coloring book
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: There are quite a few national park coloring books out there to choose from and I have quite a few different ones. Out of all the ones I have this one is my favorite because the drawings and illustrative style were designed for coloring this makes a big difference both while coloring and in the completed page once it’s colored. Most of the other books out there were originally posters from national parks converted into coloring pages. This isn’t ideal because it can make it difficult to distinguish lines and the pages can just look not quite right. I love the unique and whimsical style of these illustrations, and love all the selected national parks.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on September 13, 2025

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’ve tried several of these color books and usually end up throwing them away this one. I love because it has parks that I’ve been to and it’s not so little that it gets tedious and boring. It really makes some really nice pictures.
